title: LLM Genetic Feature Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.31277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feature Engineering is the (traditionally manual) process of constructing derived variables from an existing dataset by combining, transforming, or otherwise manipulating the original data fields to reduce statistical noise and extract meaningful, domain-specific quantities of interest from the raw dataset. Recent work demonstrates promising progress toward the au tomation of this process through the integration of large language models (LLMs) and various metaheuristics to guide the search for useful features. We build on this approach by introducing a novel genetic algorithm that implements selection, crossover, and mutation at the individual feature level, rather than at the level of the entire engineered feature set. In doing so, we enable in-process statistical analysis of newly-generated features, thereby enabling the genetic algorithm to simultaneously integrate individual and group-level feature metrics into its selec tion proce

translated_title: 大语言模型遗传特征工程
translated_abstract: 特征工程是一种（传统上由人工完成的）过程，通过组合、转换或其他方式操作原始数据字段，从现有数据集中构建派生变量，以减少统计噪声，并从原始数据中提取有意义的、特定领域的关注量。近期研究表明，通过整合大语言模型（LLM）和各种元启发式算法来指导有用特征的搜索，在特征工程自动化方面取得了可喜的进展。我们在此方法的基础上，引入了一种新颖的遗传算法，该算法在单个特征层面而非整个工程特征集层面实现选择、交叉和变异操作。由此，我们能够对新生的特征进行过程中的统计分析，从而使遗传算法能够同时将个体和群体层面的特征指标整合到其选择过程中。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种在单个特征层面而非整个特征集层面执行选择、交叉和变异的新型遗传算法，使遗传算法能够在过程中对新特征进行统计分析，并同时整合个体与群体层面的特征指标，从而改进基于LLM的特征工程自动化。
